description: The Austrian soil research team assembled physical, chemical and hydraulic properties from 2,203 sampling sites across Austria, with collection dates spanning 1992–2024. Zenodo describes inputs from project campaigns and long-term monitoring in agricultural regions, selected forests and alpine settings. Its public CC BY 4.0 archive contains six named CSV tables: site metadata, physical and chemical properties, other measurements, soil-water retention and hydraulic conductivity, plus a README. The producers state that laboratory results were harmonised and quality checked before release. Coverage is broad but consists of sites selected by different projects, not an evenly sampled national grid or a continuous series at every location. A known limitation is that methods and land management changed across the thirty-two-year span; pooling observations can hide site and measurement differences. A reviewer-assessed use is parameterising infiltration or soil-water states in catchment and irrigation simulations. model-wflow and data-isric-soilgrids-global-soil-maps are related model and mapping resources; no point-to-grid alignment was checked. No archive, table or README file was downloaded.
